appearance_facts.fact: Y-axis scale: 0 to 24.0°C, with major gridlines at 5°C intervals (0, 5, 10, 15, 20)
A single blue line connects data points for each year from 2005 to 2015.
Each data point is marked with a solid black circle and annotated with its exact temperature value.
2005 data point is at 24.0°C, located at the top of the chart.
2015 data point is at 10.0°C, located at the bottom of the chart.

public_definitions: Review the reservoir surface temperature dashboard for the 2005-2015 review period, determine whether the full-period change requires substantial-change follow-up, then submit the appropriate routing decision.
Use the dashboard to determine whether the full-period reservoir surface temperature change should enter substantial-change follow-up or remain in routine monitoring.
